mapper.select: SELECT uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, email, name, role, added_at FROM users WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND external_id IN (#{actorID}, #{targetID}) AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY uuid FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.uuid AS user_uuid, u.external_id AS user_external_id, u.role AS organization_role, COALESCE(wm.workspace_role, '') AS explicit_role FROM users u JOIN workspaces w ON w.organization_uuid = u.organization_uuid AND w.uuid = #{workspaceUUID} LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON NOT w.is_default AND wm.organization_uuid = u.organization_uuid AND wm.workspace_uuid = w.uuid AND wm.user_uuid = u.uuid AND wm.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE u.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY u.added_at DESC, u.uuid DESC
